name: browser-use
headline: Spotify Skill - Automate Music Management
short_description: Spotify Skills for Claude - Production Spotify API integration + complete toolkit for creating Claude Desktop Skills. Includes OAuth 2.0, cover art generation, automated tools, and comprehensive guides.
author: fabioc-aloha

sections.overview:
Spotify Skills for Claude provides a complete production integration with the Spotify Web API, enabling playlist creation, music search, playback control, and user data retrieval through 40+ documented methods. The skill includes three core scripts: spotify_client.py for OAuth 2.0 authenticated API access, playlist_creator.py supporting five playlist creation strategies, and cover_art_generator.py for generating custom SVG-based cover art and converting to PNG images—a capability Claude lacks natively. The package includes comprehensive documentation covering OAuth 2.0 setup, API reference, and content-driven design guidelines. Development tools provide automated skill creation, validation, and packaging capabilities for building additional Claude skills.
Create and manage Spotify playlists by artist, mood, theme, or lyrical content
Search and discover music tracks, artists, and albums programmatically
Control Spotify playback (play, pause, skip, volume) via Claude conversations
Generate custom playlist cover art with content-driven design and WCAG accessibility
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/fabioc-aloha/spotify-skill`
sections.usage:
```
I want to create a Spotify playlist for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. The playlist should include [NUMBER] tracks that fit the mood of [MOOD]. Can you generate a list of songs and create a new playlist titled '[PLAYLIST_NAME]' on my Spotify account?
```
Copy

```
# Spotify Playlist Creation for [COMPANY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
